questions.question: 1) What is the primary purpose of the VR Interaction Showcase experiment?

answers.a: To explore chemistry reactions in VR
answers.b: To understand different VR interaction techniques
answers.d: To develop a new VR game

explanations.a: Incorrect. This experiment focuses on VR interactions, not chemistry.
explanations.b: Correct. The goal of the experiment is to educate users on different VR interaction techniques.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The experiment is about VR interactions, not hardware testing.
explanations.d: Incorrect. While the knowledge gained can be applied in game development, the experiment is not about game creation
